Edit.Title: Preset Editor
Edit.Subtitle: Create your own preset with ReShade, live on map screenshots. When you're happy with it, save it to your library.

Close Dead by Daylight before installing.

While the game is open ReShade's files are in use, and ReShade would undo the changes when the game closes.

Edit.ProposeTip: Send your preset to be added to the official library for everyone
Edit.ProposeInfo:
Your preset will be packed into a .zip with its screenshot and description, and its folder will open.

Then GitHub opens with a ready-made submission: drag the .zip into the text box and press Create. You need a free GitHub account; you can also share the .zip on our Discord.

Continue?

Inst.PopularTip: Among the most installed presets by the community
Set.ShareUsage: Share anonymous install counts for the community ranking
Set.ShareUsageText: When you install an official preset, the app sends only its file name and a random id of this installation, so it is counted once. No account, name or IP address is stored. The counts power the "Most used" filter.
